metadata.title: Banninkhoeve — Farmhouse B&B in Heino, Overijssel | Salland Countryside
metadata.description: Unique guest accommodation in a converted farmhouse back house near Heino. Peaceful rural setting, homemade breakfast, wheelchair accessible. Perfect for walkers, cyclists, and nature lovers. Rated 8.9/10.

footer.tagline: Peace, nature, and farmhouse charm in the heart of Salland

about.title: About Banninkhoeve
about.storyP1: Banninkhoeve is a residential farmhouse whose back house has been transformed into a unique guest accommodation. Located just outside the village of Heino in the province of Overijssel, our B&B offers an authentic stay in the beautiful Salland region.
about.storyP2: Surrounded by meadows, farmland, and scenic cycling and walking routes, Banninkhoeve is the ideal base for nature lovers. The bustling cities of Zwolle and Deventer are a short drive away, while the peaceful countryside is right on your doorstep.
about.storyP3: Your host Tea takes pride in offering a warm, personal welcome and a delicious breakfast featuring local and homemade products — with vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free options always available on request.

testimonials.title: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.testimonial1: Amazing experience! The farmhouse is beautiful and the breakfast was delicious. Will definitely come back.
testimonials.testimonial2: The perfect place for a countryside getaway. Tea was incredibly welcoming and helpful with local walking routes.
testimonials.testimonial3: Beautiful property with attention to every detail. The garden is stunning and the location couldn't be better for cycling.
